categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: market business and service support for vaccine manufacturers, focusing on non-immunization vaccines promotion, and architectural interior design services covering commercial complexes, office complexes, medical and elderly care complexes, transportation complexes, and cultural and educational complexes. Additionally, it engages in soft decoration product sales and related consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital design technologies including BIM (Building Information Modeling), AI-assisted design tools, and intelligent project management platforms. It emphasizes integrated design services from concept to construction drawings, incorporating smart construction, low-carbon sustainable design, and modular prefabrication technologies. The R&D efforts focus on AI-driven design assistants, digital material libraries, and energy-efficient mechanical and electrical design solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include vaccine manufacturers requiring market promotion and service support, as well as real estate developers and urban complex project owners needing comprehensive interior architectural design. The vaccine promotion business targets healthcare providers and community vaccination points, while the design business serves commercial real estate, office buildings, healthcare and elderly care facilities, transportation hubs, and cultural and educational institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in China, with a strong presence in Guangdong province and expanding networks in Guangxi, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, and other regions. It also explores international markets, including Hong Kong and Shanghai, through subsidiaries and joint ventures, aiming to build a global promotion and design service capability.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. In the vaccine industry, it acts as a service provider facilitating market promotion and business support between vaccine manufacturers (upstream) and end customers (downstream). In architectural design, it provides design and consulting services directly to project developers and owners, positioned downstream in the construction value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on dual core businesses: expanding vaccine market business and advancing architectural interior design. R&D priorities include AI-assisted design tools, BIM-based intelligent design and construction platforms, digital material databases, and energy-efficient mechanical and electrical design innovations. The company pursues digital transformation, smart construction, low-carbon sustainable design, and integrated project lifecycle management to enhance efficiency and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service fees from vaccine market business support and architectural interior design contracts. The design business recognizes revenue based on project progress and delivery milestones, while the vaccine business recognizes revenue upon service completion. Additional income comes from sales of soft decoration products and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China’s architectural interior design sector, recognized as the first interior design firm listed on the A-share market with strong brand reputation and numerous industry awards. In vaccine market services, it holds a significant position with a nationwide network and professional teams, competing with other specialized service providers in the healthcare promotion sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 585.9 million, a 21.74% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.99 million. The decline was due to reduced orders in the interior design segment and market fluctuations in vaccine services. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.17 billion, with equity of RMB 737.4 million. The company faces short-term profitability challenges but continues investing in R&D and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through integrated, full-chain interior design services combining architectural, mechanical, electrical, lighting, and decoration design with strong digital and AI capabilities. Its vaccine market business offers comprehensive, compliant, and professional promotion services with deep regional penetration and expert teams. The firm emphasizes innovation, quality, and sustainability, leveraging advanced technologies and strategic partnerships to deliver high-value, customized solutions to clients.
